claims.claim: Anthropic announced September 16 that Claude chat and Cowork are merging into one experience.
The rollout is gradual, beginning with Pro and Max; same-plan accounts can differ; Team and Free follow; Enterprise receives at least 30 days notice.
Manual is default and asks before actions; Auto works with fewer check-ins; the setting applies to the whole conversation.
Cloud tasks can continue after laptop closure, while local files/apps require Claude Desktop open.
